data.content_ref: inline:SRC_001's registry-size account reduces to SRC_004's order-effect explanation as a special case: the mutation count per module determines whether a given guard installation order can produce a measurable selective effect, so the observed asymmetry is a function of both order and size, not a general testing condition. Refuted if ordinarily-guarded modules each had dozens of mutations and still lost 4/4 to 6/7, or if mutation proposal and guard installation order were randomized across the project and the asymmetry persisted.
